baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated maqt sets two severe aversions toward the same ugly refusal on one comparative scale: divine appraisal exceeds the offenders' later reflexive appraisal.

activation_trace.role: Severe abhorrence of ugly conduct supplies both terms of the comparison rather than two unrelated emotions.
Magnitude opposed to smallness makes akbar a calibration of unequal moral measures.
The self as the thing's own identity makes the second maqt reflexive and turns judgment inward.

changed_reading.before: A future announcement says that God hated them more than they hated themselves.
changed_reading.after: The announcement compares an already exact divine valuation of their ugly refusal with their belated, still smaller act of self-valuation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُنَادَوْنَ ... إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Two passive calls form a temporal reversal: an earlier invitation that allowed response is answered by covering, then a later public summons announces the consequence and allows no evasive response.

activation_trace.role: Raised voice and calling make the later address an audible summons.
The parallel mapped inventory reinforces the public, extended voice of the summons.
Calling that inclines another by speech gives the earlier invitation a directional offer.
Heart-settling assent names the offered destination of the earlier call.
Blocking the truth is both the identity announced at the start and the immediate response marked by the final fa.

changed_reading.before: The verse contains an announcement and a recollection of an invitation.
changed_reading.after: The announcement is the returned form of the rejected invitation: the voice they would not answer becomes the voice that publicly fixes what their answer was.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same root opens and closes the ayah, enclosing the summons, comparison, self, and invitation inside a repeated act of covering; the final fa presents covering as a produced response, not merely a static label.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the enclosing material image around everything said between the two occurrences.
Obstruction of truth specifies what the repeated covering does at the invitation.
The spoken inclination toward faith is the incoming movement that the covering blocks.

changed_reading.before: Kafaru simply classifies the addressees, and takfurun repeats that classification.
changed_reading.after: The first occurrence names the settled enclosure whose formation the last clause replays: a call arrives, and they actively cover its destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prelude contrasts two coverings: human covering blocks truth, while divine covering shields a returned sinner from a sin's effect. Mercy's breadth makes the contrast functional rather than merely verbal.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the shared material operation whose object and result differ.
Covering a sin while protecting its bearer supplies the reparative counterpart to obstructive covering.
Repeated requests for protected covering keep that reparative possibility immediately before the focus.
Expansiveness opposed to constriction prevents the focus maqt from being read as the only available divine relation.
Tender mercy names the wider field within which protective covering is requested.

structural_cues: 40:3 names forgiveness, accepted return, and severe consequence together.
40:7-9 immediately precede the focus with intercession, expansive mercy, forgiveness, protection, and rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent obstructive and protective branch images of covering; I infer a contrast based on what is covered and toward what end. The live alternative is simple lexical recurrence without deliberate material counterpoint.

changed_reading.before: Their kufr is only a covered refusal that incurs divine aversion.
changed_reading.after: Their obstructive covering rejects the very relation in which another kind of covering could protect them; the maqt marks refusal of an already-open reparative possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate reply and diagnosis convert generic unbelief into asymmetric allegiance: they confess only after the summons, and in life they rejected when God alone was invoked but assented when partnership was introduced.

activation_trace.role: Admission and submission turn the focus self-maqt into belated acknowledgment rather than mere distress.
Named sins give the belated inward aversion a confessed object.
Calling by speech repeats the focus invitation and specifies its disputed object.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the condition under which they refused.
Blocking truth is explicitly paired with the call to God alone.
Association with God supplies the rival condition under which assent became acceptable.
Assent appears on the partnership side of the conditional mirror, exposing selective rather than absent belief.

structural_cues: 40:11 is the speakers' direct response to the proclamation in 40:10.
40:12 begins with a causal diagnosis and mirrors call-alone/reject against partnership/assent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession followed by an explicit conditional asymmetry; I infer that 40:12 diagnoses the refusal recalled in 40:10. A live alternative is that 40:12 explains the punishment generally rather than every nuance of the focus invitation.

changed_reading.before: They were called to faith but lacked or rejected belief.
changed_reading.after: They were capable of assent but refused its exclusive direction; their later self-maqt recognizes a chosen allegiance pattern exposed by the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judgment removes the cover spatially and epistemically: persons stand exposed, each self receives what it acquired, and even what chests hide is known. Self-maqt is therefore forced self-recognition under complete disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the condition that the later exposure reverses.
The self as one's own identity anchors the disclosed account back to anfusakum.
Appearance and uncovering turn judgment into an exposed field.
Concealment is explicitly negated, closing the hiding function of kufr.
Act-for-act requital supplies the accounting mechanism behind the comparative aversion.
Every individual identity is made the unit that receives its own account.
Acquisition makes the disclosed outcome something accumulated by the self.
The chest as the source from which acts issue locates the previously hidden interior now known.

structural_cues: 40:16 repeats the judgment day and negates all hiding.
40:17 places every nafs in an exact acquisition-to-requital relation.
40:19 moves disclosure from public appearance to concealed interior sources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, exposure, individual requital, acquisition, and known interiors; I infer that disclosure causes the self-directed maqt. The alternative is that self-maqt is simply another punishment emotion alongside, not produced by, accounting.

changed_reading.before: They happen to hate themselves when punishment arrives.
changed_reading.after: Their self-hatred is the subjective recoil of an uncovered account: the covering fails, the acquired act is returned to its own self, and no hidden interior can soften it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later maqt recurrence identifies a self-reinforcing mechanism: unsupported argument twists around signs, pride occupies the inner source, and repeated refusal takes a seal-like form. The same akbar-min frame elsewhere confirms scalar calibration.

activation_trace.role: The focus's doubled severe abhorrence is the relation that the later recurrence diagnoses.
The inward field of reasoning and intent allows heart and chest cues to specify what the hated self had been doing.
Twisted contention supplies the active conduct that attracts the repeated maqt.
The absent compelling warrant makes the contention self-authorized rather than evidence-driven.
The exact severe-aversion branch recurs around unsupported disputation.
Stamping and sealing turn reiterated refusal into a fixed receptive surface.
The heart locates the sealed surface in the inner organ of orientation.
Grandeur and self-exaltation connect the greatness of the aversion with the disputant's arrogated greatness.
The chest as the source of action houses the pride driving the dispute.
A second akbar-min construction confirms that the surah uses this form to correct mismatched scales.

structural_cues: 40:35 repeats both maqt and k-b-r, then links the pattern to a sealed arrogant heart.
40:56 repeats unsupported disputation and locates unattainable pride in the chests.
40:57 repeats the exact comparative frame akbar min for cosmic scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical and constructional recurrences plus inner sealing; I infer that they explain why the focus comparison is unequal. The alternative is that these are parallel examples of arrogance and scale, not a direct causal gloss on 40:10.

changed_reading.before: God's maqt is greater as an unexplained difference of emotional intensity.
changed_reading.after: The greater measure answers a self-sealing distortion of scale: unsupported contention magnifies the self, blocks reception, and can appraise itself accurately only after the seal's world collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believer's speech stages reciprocal calls with opposed destinations: rescue versus fire, kufr and partnership versus the Mighty Forgiver. The focus invitation is one vector in a contested social field, and the judgment summons reveals which vector actually returned everyone to God.

activation_trace.role: A spoken inclination toward a destination anchors the focus invitation as directional.
Two reciprocal calls expose opposed attempts to incline one another.
Rescue by separation supplies the destination of the believer's call.
The reciprocal call is restated with its theological destinations made explicit.
Blocking truth is named as the destination toward which the opposing group calls.
Partnership specifies the rival allegiance carried by that call.
The protecting Forgiver marks the reparative destination of the counter-call.
Return to a destination closes the directional contest at God.

structural_cues: 40:41 balances I call you against you call me with rescue and fire as explicit endpoints.
40:42 specifies the opposed calls as kufr/partnership and the Mighty/Forgiver.
40:43 denies effective call to the rival object and states the common return to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatically reciprocal calls and opposed destinations; I infer that this social contest instantiates the focus's call to faith. The alternative is that the narrative is an analogous later episode rather than the specific invitation remembered in 40:10.

changed_reading.before: The call to faith is a single message delivered to isolated hearers.
changed_reading.after: The call enters a reciprocal struggle of inclinations; refusing it means answering a counter-call toward partnership, and the final summons exposes the destination chosen.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who would not answer messengers later ask the keepers to call for relief, but their call is declared lost. The call-response promise and the contrast between arrogance and abasement make nonresponse a refused relation that returns as an unanswered request.

activation_trace.role: The original spoken invitation supplies the unanswered first side of the relation.
The condemned now delegate a call for relief, reversing their earlier position as recipients.
Messengers and message identify the prior channel whose arrival they concede.
Meaning made clear by signs removes lack of disclosure as the reason for nonresponse.
The repeated call is now issued without an effective destination or answer.
Missing the intended direction characterizes the late call's failure.
The direct invitation to call supplies the open relational offer.
Answering speech supplies the promised responsive return.
Self-exaltation identifies what blocks entry into the call-response relation.
Abasement supplies the reversed posture reached after arrogant nonresponse.

structural_cues: 40:49-50 reverses call roles: former recipients become petitioners and concede that messengers came clearly.
40:60 places call and answer in one clause, then contrasts arrogant refusal with humbled entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior clear message, a later futile call, an explicit call-answer pair, and arrogance followed by abasement; I infer a returned relational failure. The alternative is that prayer and proclamation are distinct call types joined only thematically.

changed_reading.before: Their fault is rejection of the content called faith.
changed_reading.after: Their fault also has a response structure: they reject an open call-answer relation, then discover that their own urgent call no longer reaches an answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: At visible force the earlier polarity reverses exactly: they affirm God alone and disavow what they had associated, yet this faith no longer benefits. The decisive variable is not bare possession of belief-language but its target and timing before coercive sight.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent is the response offered before visible compulsion.
The focus occurrence blocks truth when the invitation still permits a consequential response.
Direct sight supplies the coercive evidentiary threshold at which the reversal occurs.
Overwhelming force is what has become visible and now drives assent.
The same assent branch appears after sight, preserving content while changing timing.
Oneness without partner is now affirmed, reversing the asymmetry diagnosed in 40:12.
Disavowal and disengagement let the same root now target the former partners rather than truth.
Association names what their belated kufr finally repudiates.
The negation of benefit marks the closed response window despite corrected content.
Belated assent remains lexically faith while being pragmatically ineffective.

structural_cues: 40:84 reverses 40:12's pairing: God alone now receives faith and the associated objects receive kufr.
40:85 states that faith after seeing force does not benefit.
The focus's idh and final fa preserve the earlier response moment as the morally diagnostic one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact polarity reversal and explicitly negated benefit; I infer that timing and target, not the mere words iman and kufr, govern the focus comparison. The alternative is that the closing scene supplies a general historical rule rather than directly resolving 40:10's temporal force.

changed_reading.before: Faith and kufr are fixed labels for two kinds of people.
changed_reading.after: They are directed responses whose objects can reverse: the condemned eventually utter the right assent and deploy kufr as repudiation of partnership, but only after sight has removed the freedom that made the earlier call answerable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant n-w-d target for n-d-w. It remains anchored in yunadawna and gains directional support from the surah's explicit overturning and turning-away cues, but downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic branch-image, not as the lexical meaning of the verb.

activation_trace.role: Swaying and movement add a contained kinetic image to the otherwise audible summons.
The named day of mutual calling extends that kinetic image from one summons to the judgment scene.
Overturning something from its direction supplies the long prior motion that judgment arrests.
Being turned from a face or direction reinforces recurrent directional displacement.

changed_reading.before: They are audibly summoned to hear a verdict.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the summons also arrests a history of swerving: those repeatedly turned from the call are finally made to face one public direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because anfusakum ordinarily denotes the persons themselves, while the activated branch foregrounds force, grandeur, and pride. It remains anchored in the packet's n-f-s inventory and is sharpened by pride located in hearts and chests, but prose should say the self is read as a pride-bearing self-formation, not claim that nafs simply means arrogance here.

activation_trace.role: Force of self, grandeur, and pride make the object of hatred a previously inflated self-formation.
Self-exaltation joins great maqt to the arrogant subject who generated it.
The heart locates that self-exalting formation inwardly.
The chest as an originating interior houses the stated pride.
Unattainable self-exaltation supplies the structure that later collapses into self-maqt.

changed_reading.before: They hate their bare selves because those selves are suffering.
changed_reading.after: They hate the magnified self they had built and obeyed: judgment collapses its claimed greatness, leaving that self-construction as the immediate object of recoil.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel makes the rejected faith-call a selective allegiance problem: they could assent to partnership but not to God alone.
Exposure and individual requital turn self-maqt into the recoil of an uncovered account rather than an unstructured punishment emotion.
Reciprocal calls and the later failed petition make the focus a reversed call-response relation.
The closing polarity reversal shows that correct faith and disavowal after coercive sight are too late, sharpening the temporal force of idh.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence did not merely amplify punishment. It differentiated kinds of covering, traced calls toward opposed destinations, repeated maqt with sealed inner pride, and finally let the same kufr root change target when the response window had closed.
remaining_uncertainties: The protective-covering contrast between gh-f-r and k-f-r is materially coherent but may be associative rather than an intended lexical pairing.
The social call scenes clearly instantiate the mechanism, but they need not be the identical historical invitation recalled by the focus.
The n-w-d swaying image is explicitly form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The pride-bearing nafs reading supplements rather than replaces the ordinary reflexive sense of anfusakum.
